program: Wingless external raw-input to repaired multi-step prediction to bounded reasoning failure attribution
question: Why did the supported low-support transition repair improve exact multi-step prediction but fail to improve the frozen three-class reasoning readout?
hypothesis: On the exact sealed substrate and heldout queries, attribute the failed reasoning bridge using three frozen controls: exact terminal top-1 correctness for transition quality, repaired distributional class versus repaired top-1 class projection for aggregation, and the fraction of exact-motif repair gains that are invisible under the training-frozen COMMON/MID/RARE partition for readout ceiling. The dominant failure signature will be identifiable without changing learned capacity or readout assignments.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: The repaired predictive distribution remained valid and aggregation beat top-1 projection, yet the frozen commonality task did not benefit relative to the unrepaired baseline. Attribution must distinguish transition-level, aggregation-level, and readout-level causes before any capacity change.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.repaired_relation: byte-identical supported 0.5 current-row plus 0.5 overflow-row backoff for exact-pair support below 3
frozen_reuse.reasoning_readout: byte-identical training-frozen COMMON/MID/RARE rank partition from the negative bridge

attribution_protocol.heldout_role: scoring and diagnostic counting only; never selection or tuning
attribution_protocol.transition_control: compare baseline versus repaired terminal top-1 motif correctness on identical depth-2/depth-3 heldout queries
attribution_protocol.aggregation_control: compare repaired distributional class decision versus repaired terminal top-1 class projection on identical queries
attribution_protocol.readout_ceiling_control: among queries where repaired terminal top-1 changes an incorrect baseline motif to the correct terminal motif, count how often the baseline and repaired top-1 motifs map to the same frozen reasoning class or the baseline class answer was already correct

attribution_rules.transition_failure: Validity passes and repaired exact top-1 depth-3 accuracy does not exceed baseline exact top-1 depth-3 accuracy.
attribution_rules.aggregation_failure: Validity passes, repaired exact top-1 improves, and repaired distributional class accuracy is at least 0.005 below repaired top-1 class projection.
attribution_rules.readout_ceiling: Validity passes, repaired exact top-1 improves, aggregation is not failing, class-level repaired-minus-baseline accuracy is nonpositive, and at least 0.50 of exact-gain queries are hidden by the frozen readout (same-class motif correction or baseline class already correct).
attribution_rules.distributed: Validity passes but none of the three preregistered signatures dominates.
attribution_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, relation identity, readout identity, determinism, capacity, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed negative parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and external manifest.
Baseline relation, repaired relation, motif representation, runtime cap, horizons, and frozen class assignments are byte-identical in semantics to the sealed bridge.
Heldout labels are used only for scoring fixed controls and diagnostic counts; they never choose thresholds, rows, classes, or successor mechanism.
Duplicate complete probes are byte-identical and probability mass remains normalized within tolerance.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, learned-capacity growth, adaptive readout growth, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, repair rule, support threshold, class assignments, runtime cap, horizons, attribution controls, 0.005 aggregation margin, 0.50 readout-ceiling fraction, metrics, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_transition_failure.intent: localize why exact predictive improvement from the prior repair did not reproduce under the bridge probe before changing capacity

successor_if_aggregation_failure.intent: test one bounded training-frozen probability aggregation repair without changing relation capacity

successor_if_readout_ceiling.intent: test one bounded training-only refinement of the abstract readout while preserving the learned relation substrate

successor_if_distributed.intent: factor the remaining transition/aggregation/readout interactions without capacity growth
